calls.title: Chaos + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Chaos is focusing on maturing its experimentation capabilities to gain insights into user behavior and optimize conversion rates. Jake Wallace emphasized the importance of full funnel attribution to address measurement gaps and cater to multiple user types, including B2B, B2C, and the education sector. Their past experimentation leaned more towards B2B thinking, yet user flows resemble B2C. The integration of GrowthBook will facilitate better data access and experimentation, building upon the foundational tools currently in use. With traffic around 1 million visits, Chaos is well-positioned for statistically valid experiments. The team plans to commence experimentation soon, pending documentation review and internal discussions for proving concepts.
calls.keywords: A/B Testing, Feature Flags, Experimentation, Roketta CMS, Core Web Vitals, Product Analytics
calls.action_items:

**Bozhidar Kamenski**
Review GrowthBook documentation on integration and compliance and send any additional technical questions following review (50:20)

**Jake Wallace**
Coordinate internal review of GrowthBook materials and sync with team to determine next steps for proof of concept or initial experimentation launch (51:40)

**Logan Bates**
